character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A small friendly humanoid laboratory robot for a cooperative 2D pixel-art puzzle platformer. Compact, stocky proportions, a large rounded-square head with a broad flat top, a short torso, two clearly separated arms, short sturdy legs and chunky flat-soled boots. Sky-blue armor, pale ivory face panel, dark navy joints, and one wide horizontal amber visor. Empty mitten-shaped hands, ready to push objects and carry a prism. Simple readable silhouette, large clean color blocks, limited palette, minimal shading and crisp pixel edges. Eye-level orthographic camera suitable for a side-scrolling game. Neutral standing pose, feet flat, full body visible and centered with a small transparent margin. No antenna, weapons, cape, backpack, text, scenery or glow effects.
